Equine Herpesvirus Outbreak Leads to Postponement of Horse Events in New Brunswick

An outbreak of equine herpesvirus (EHV-1) in New Brunswick has led to the postponement or cancellation of several horse events. Horse owners have been warned about potential virus exposure. The virus can cause respiratory illness, abortions in mares, and neurological issues in horses. Biosecurity measures are being implemented to control the spread.
